description: This file declares the KernelLogServer class and related enums and types for managing kernel log connections in the cuttlefish::monitor namespace. It includes method declarations for handling incoming messages, managing subscriptions, and preparing for select system calls.

classes.name: KernelLogServer
classes.description: Manages an incoming kernel log connection from the VMM, allowing subscription to events and handling communication with a single client.

methods.name: KernelLogServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server with a pipe file descriptor and log name.

methods.name: BeforeSelect
methods.description: Prepares the set of file descriptors before calling select.

methods.name: AfterSelect
methods.description: Handles the file descriptors after select indicates activity.

methods.name: SubscribeToEvents
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked on specific events.

methods.name: HandleIncomingMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from the client; returns false if the client disconnected.
